summary: A ResQ item that cannot be exported is skipped by name instead of failing its whole reserving-class import.
details: The Bridge now commits the rest of the reserving class and reports each skipped item; any existing ArcRho copy of a skipped item is kept under both Merge and Overwrite.
Both import macros list the skipped items by name in their completion message, so the operator sees exactly which methods to repair in ResQ.
A blank method input is reported by the ResQ field that needs fixing (Latest, Exposure, Perc Developed, or Prior) rather than a generic precedent error.
